opening.argument: The presentation solicits viewers to register with Bitconnect and invest, directing them to a lending process after obtaining tokens. It states, “You're at least required to make $100 investment,” then presents a 299-day term yielding “a profit of almost $300” and instructs the viewer to accept the terms and pay. The interface reinforces that solicitation with lending tiers, daily interest accrual, capital release, and a payment button. A separate page displays an interest-rate chart, projected earnings, and language that the interest rate can be guaranteed. The speaker also reports earning more than $5 from a $160 investment in two days. These displayed terms and reported earnings are not independently verified, and the available evidence does not establish that they were genuine or representative.
